title: Ruhu Mai Tamani Wanda Ya Yi Tambaya Kan Iko
intro: A cikin tarihin Alƙur'ani, akwai wani mutum wanda dukiyarsa da iliminsa suka zama tarihi. Wannan rai ya fito daga ƙasa da kayan ado da wadata waɗanda suka burge masu kallo, amma zuciyarsu ta yi girman kai da alfahari. Ku biyo mu yayin da muke warware asirin ɗaya daga cikin tatsuniyoyi mafiya muhimmanci na Alƙur'ani, inda girman duniya ya haɗu da ƙarshen ƙasƙanci a ƙarƙashin ƙasa da ta haifar da arzikinsu.
clues: Na fito daga ƙasa ina ƙawata ta da kayan ado waɗanda suka ja hankalin kowa.
Na mallaki dukiya mai yawa da kuma zurfin ilimi wanda ya bambanta ni da wasu.
Lokacin da wani manzo ya zo yana kiran mutane zuwa ga Allah, na yi tambaya game da ikonsu da alfahari.
Wadanda ke kewaye da ni sun yi rada cewa ni'imar Allah ba ita ce tushen arzikina ba.
Mutanena sun yi mamakin girman da na ke da shi kuma sun yi fatan samun makoma irin tawa.
An haɗiye gine-ginena masu ban mamaki gaba ɗaya a cikin ƙasa a matsayin azabar Allah.

arabic: وَقَـٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَـٰبِقِينَ
verse: And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment]. (29:39)
